name: n4_alarm_text_check
description: Check the alarm source extensions below base for alarm texts that can never show what their author meant (kit rule LC9, build-n4-module-kit/types/logic.md; the live twin of bog-nav alarm-text, same rules and rows). The texts of a BAlarmSourceExt (toOffnormalText, toFaultText, toNormalText) are resolved against the alarm record, never the source, and every return to normal sets the record's msgText to toNormalText. Rules (each finding is {level: WARN, rule, path, slot, token, text}, in slot path order): parent-path, a %...% token rooted at no BAlarmRecord field (%parent...% or any source-slot path such as %out.value%; one row per token): use %alarmData.<key>%; empty-tonormal, toOffnormalText set with toNormalText empty, which blanks msgText on every return to normal (token and text empty). Not reported: %alarmData.<key>%, the other record fields (%sourceState%, %alarmClass%, ...), a function call such as %lexicon(module:key)%, and %%. alarm_extensions counts every extension read (BQL's from matches subtypes); summary is the one-line count; truncated with note means max_rows or the byte cap cut the read and the counts are lower bounds. Read-only: one BQL select of slotPath and the three texts from alarm:AlarmSourceExt below base.

base.description: Subtree ORD to check, default the whole station (station:|slot:/)

max_rows.description: Row cap of the select (extensions read)

timeout_s.description: HTTP timeout per request in seconds
